thread:
Maria Chen: Hey team — prepping assets for the May 7 webinar + three short launch posts. Need a compact "story card" pack (social + 2 slide sizes + one vertical) and a single-page benchmark infographic derived from the latest latency/cost numbers. Can we scope designs + localization checklist by EOD tomorrow?

Liam O'Neill: On it. Quick Q: do we want the cards to be data-forward (numbers prominent) or narrative-forward (problem → benefit → CTA)?

Arjun Patel: Data-forward for the webinar promo (lead magnets perform better), narrative-forward for organic posts. So we need both variants.

Ada Rivera: Gotcha. For production: will produce 3 master artboards in Figma and variants exported for ENG/FR/DE. Need the final numbers and any legal copy.

Maria Chen: Numbers are in the deck linked below — use the summary slide: 85% throughput improvement, median p95 latency 42ms, 28% lower token cost with the new batching config. Also: add the new privacy-safe blurb: "No customer prompts are logged for hosted demo" (confirmed with Security).

figma-bot: New file created: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/redwood-story-cards — Liam, Ada added as editors.

Liam O'Neill: Sketching structure: 1) hero statistic card (big number + microcaption), 2) comparison card (before/after sparkline + icons), 3) CTA card (webinar registration). Will follow brand type stack but want permission for a denser grid to fit numbers.

Noah (Brand Ops): Dense grid okay as long as we preserve whitespace token and use approved palette (Primary #0E4FFF, Accent #06C2A6). No new fonts; use Inter. Make sure contrast ratios meet AA.

Ada Rivera: Accessibility note: if using small numeric type on hero, include a large accessible label and export a text-only variant for alt copy. Also recommend 1200x1200, 1200x628, and 1080x1920 exports.

Sarah (Legal): Confirming the privacy blurb — please add linked legal CTA: "Data & Privacy" that points to /legal/data. Also avoid using customer names in examples. Otherwise good.

Arjun Patel: For localization: translate short captions only (headline + CTA + one stat note). We'll keep body microcopy in EN for all markets for speed. Can we auto-generate FR/DE headlines and have in-line QA?

Liam O'Neill: I can add locale variants in Figma using the i18n frames plugin; will add a QA checklist frame per locale.

Maria Chen: Timeline check: initial sketches by EOD today, Figma masters by EOD tomorrow, exports + delivery by Wed morning (May 6). Is that realistic?

Ada Rivera: EOD sketches yes. Masters tomorrow if we lock numbers and privacy blurb now. Exports Wed AM — need one engineering screenshot from Arjun to show the runtime dashboard for a webinar slide.

Arjun Patel: I'll drop the dashboard screenshot in the figma file by 2pm today.

Noah (Brand Ops): Also want a one-page "brand compliance checklist" to go in the handoff with exports: color tokens, spacing token, alt text examples, legal snippet. I'll draft it and add to the file.

Maria Chen: Perfect. Owners: Liam + Ada = design; Noah = brand checklist; Arjun = data + screenshot; Sarah = legal copy signoff. Please add time estimates in the file and tag me when ready. :thumbsup:

Liam O'Neill: Will do. Starting sketching now.

Ada Rivera: Adding initial frames in Figma, ping when screenshot is in.

figma-bot: Comment added on frame "hero-stat" by Liam O'Neill: "increase line-height for readability"

Sarah (Legal): Quick reminder — for Europe markets include the GDPR blurb variant: "Requests are processed in accordance with GDPR; no content is retained for model training."

Maria Chen: Thanks — include that as a locale-specific footer for EU assets. Team — thank you, will check back on the masters tomorrow morning.
